title: The Fortune Machine Said SATURDAY 🎡
description:
The fortune machine at our county fair has never once been wrong. One guy got "you'll get wet" and ten minutes later he was in the dunk tank.

Mine said I'd break my Uncle Ray's heart on Saturday. So I made a plan to stay out of his way all week.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment SANDWICH if you'd have shown up too.
